description: This file defines REST API endpoints for authentication-related operations using FastAPI. It includes functionality for OAuth login flows, token exchange, token refresh, and API key management, including schema models, route handlers, and internal helpers.

classes.name: OAuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Request schema for initiating OAuth login process.

classes.name: OAuthLoginResponse
classes.description: Response schema providing the authorization URL and state token.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response schema after OAuth callback processing, including token info.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshRequest
classes.description: Request schema for refreshing OAuth tokens.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshResponse
classes.description: Response schema for OAuth token refresh.

classes.name: ApiKeyUpsertRequest
classes.description: Schema for setting/updating an API key for a connection.

classes.name: ApiKeyVerifyRequest
classes.description: Schema to verify an API key against stored hash.

classes.name: ApiKeyResponse
classes.description: Response schema indicating success and validity of API key operations.

classes.name: OAuthState
classes.description: TypedDict for OAuth state parameter encapsulating tenant/connection identifiers and nonce.

methods.name: _tenant_tokens_collection(tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Helper to get the database collection for tenant tokens.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _upsert_oauth_tokens( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: Optional[str], expires_in: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Inserts or updates OAuth tokens in the database.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_oauth_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches existing OAuth token record for tenant and connection.

methods.name: None _upsert_api_key( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, api_key_plain: str, header_name: Optional[str], prefix: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Stores or updates hashed API key information.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse set_api_key_async(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Async handler to store API key for a connection.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse verify_api_key_route(req: ApiKeyVerifyRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Endpoint to verify provided API key matches stored hash.

methods.name: OAuthLoginResponse oauth_login(req: OAuthLoginRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Starts OAuth flow, generates authorization URL and state token.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackResponse oauth_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code returned by the provider."), state: str = Query(..., description="Opaque state parameter returned by the provider."), error: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error returned by provider."), error_description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error description."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Handles OAuth provider redirect, exchanges code for tokens, stores credentials.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResponse oauth_refresh(req: OAuthRefreshRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Uses stored refresh token to obtain new access token.
